audit.why: EVEN 6/10 matches 49.9% over 2970 games; Renekton owns 2-3 and 6, the lane normalises once item parity arrives.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two chart rows disagreed with both the packet chart and the matchup's own prose: Level 6 said Skill on both layers, and 2+ items said Renekton on both layers.
audit.why: whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all describe level 6 as your clearest window (Dominus HP plus Fury acceleration chaining empowered Ws) — packet levelChart[4] is 'Renekton'. whys[6] and late both say the duel normalises and to stop forcing 1v1s — packet levelChart[6] is 'Skill'.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Renekton on both layers; 2+ items to Skill on both layers, with both why lines restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Wukong ability, and report[5] treated Nimbus Strike as the decisive interaction when the decoy is.
audit.why: Packet enemyAbilities: P Stone Skin, Q Crushing Blow, W Warrior Trickster, E Nimbus Strike, R Cyclone. The interaction that actually decides the lane is Warrior Trickster's decoy eating your empowered W — a 1.5s stun spent on a clone is the whole trade.
audit.corrected: Name Warrior Trickster and Nimbus Strike in the content layer; make report[5] state the decoy rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text asserted the clone is 'a free dodge window every 20s'.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits has no Wukong entry in this brief (enemyKit is null), so no cooldown for Warrior Trickster is verifiable from the data I am permitted to read. An unverifiable number is worse than none.
audit.corrected: Removed the 20s claim, kept the mechanic.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Wukong's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus HP and Fury acceleration let you chain empowered Ws — even a clone dodge only buys him one, so this is your clearest all-in.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Wukong carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: his Trinity Force spike matches yours and Cyclone threatens any duel. Wukong carry threat 7/10 — take objectives, not 1v1s.

edits.before: Your E-stun-Q sequence comes online and his E is your primary tracker — he cannot dodge the empowered W-stun if you land E first and his dash is cooling down.
edits.after: Your E-stun-Q sequence comes online and Nimbus Strike (E) is what you track — he cannot dodge the empowered W-stun if you land E first while his dash is down.

edits.before: His W clone becomes a real trade tool — never commit the empowered W-stun until you see the real body, or he escapes clean and your stun window is wasted.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster (W) becomes a real trade tool — never commit the empowered W-stun until you see the real body, or he escapes clean and your stun is wasted.

edits.before: Wukong's W clone buys him a free dodge window every 20s — if you W-stun the decoy, his real body walks away clean and resets the trade in his favor.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster (W) buys him a free dodge window — if you W-stun the decoy, his real body walks away clean and resets the trade in his favor.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster's decoy is the bait — spend the stun only on whatever damages you.

edits.before: Track Wukong's Nimbus Strike: His engage dash. Bait it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster's decoy eats your stun — spend empowered W only on the real body.

notes: enemyKit is NULL in this brief — no Wukong kit file was supplied, so no cooldowns, ranges or flags were verifiable. I used only the packet's ability names and removed the one unverifiable number (clone 'every 20s'). Cooldown windows (point 6) and any Cyclone/Crushing Blow numbers are left unaudited for this matchup for that reason. Chart edits are proposed as one atomic group: two matched pairs (Level 6 and 2+ items).
